cases.purpose: Communicate the archive batch limit.
cases.source: The archive accepts batches of no more than seventy files. A batch of sixty files is proposed.
cases.transformation: The archive accepts batches of no more than ninety files. A batch of sixty files is proposed.

obligations.source_quote: The archive accepts batches of no more than seventy files.

cases.purpose: Communicate the review-queue boundary.
cases.source: The review queue accepts batches of no more than eighteen items.
cases.transformation: The review queue accepts batches of fewer than eighteen items.

obligations.source_quote: The review queue accepts batches of no more than eighteen items.

cases.purpose: Communicate the escalation threshold.
cases.source: Escalation is permitted after at least eight continuous minutes of lag. The dashboard shows ten minutes.
cases.transformation: Escalation is permitted after more than eight continuous minutes of lag. The dashboard shows ten minutes.

obligations.source_quote: Escalation is permitted after at least eight continuous minutes of lag.

cases.purpose: Communicate the cache retention and deletion rules.
cases.source: The cache may retain entries for twelve minutes. Deletion requires a signed request.
cases.transformation: The cache may retain entries for twenty minutes. Deletion requires a signed request.

obligations.source_quote: The cache may retain entries for twelve minutes.
Deletion requires a signed request.

cases.purpose: Communicate the key exception.
cases.source: The key may be used during an incident, except when the audit ticket is closed.
cases.transformation: The key may be used during an incident, except when the audit is unresolved.

obligations.source_quote: except when the audit ticket is closed
obligations.description: The exception scope must not be broadened.

cases.purpose: Communicate whether the technician may enter the clean room.
cases.source: The technician may enter the clean room only if the training is current and an escort is assigned. The training is current. No escort is assigned.
cases.transformation: The technician may enter the clean room because the training is current.

obligations.source_quote: only if the training is current and an escort is assigned

cases.purpose: Communicate who approved which plan.
cases.source: Auditor: "The retention schedule is approved." Lead: "The deletion plan is approved."
cases.transformation: Lead: "The retention schedule is approved." Auditor: "The deletion plan is approved."

obligations.source_quote: Auditor: "The retention schedule is approved."
Lead: "The deletion plan is approved."

cases.purpose: Communicate the ethics approval status.
cases.source: The ethics approval has not been decided. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: The ethics approval is granted; the record contains the approval.

obligations.source_quote: The ethics approval has not been decided.

cases.purpose: Communicate the roof-hatch permission.
cases.source: The facilities team is permitted to unlock the roof hatch. The work order is recorded.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the facilities team is permitted to unlock the roof hatch.

obligations.source_quote: The facilities team is permitted to unlock the roof hatch.

cases.purpose: Communicate the batch failure and the investigation status.
cases.source: The batch failed after the temperature change. The lab says the cause has not been established.
cases.transformation: The temperature change caused the batch failure; the lab established the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The lab says the cause has not been established.

cases.purpose: Communicate what the auditor approved.
cases.source: The auditor approved the exception. The note does not say whether "the exception" means the retention exception or the access exception.
cases.transformation: The auditor approved the retention exception.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the exception" means the retention exception or the access exception.

cases.purpose: Communicate what the note establishes.
cases.source: The note records a failed migration. It does not authorise rollback.
cases.transformation: The operator may roll back the release without approval.

obligations.source_quote: It does not authorise rollback.

cases.purpose: State the sample storage limit using an equivalent upper bound.
cases.source: Samples may be stored for up to twenty-one days.
cases.transformation: The sample storage limit is no more than twenty-one days.

obligations.source_quote: Samples may be stored for up to twenty-one days.

cases.purpose: Reorder the access conditions without changing them.
cases.source: Access requires a current badge and a completed briefing.
cases.transformation: A completed briefing and a current badge are required for access.

obligations.source_quote: Access requires a current badge and a completed briefing.

cases.purpose: Summarize the paging rule; the desk location is irrelevant to the task.
cases.source: The desk may page the engineer when queue delay exceeds thirty seconds for six minutes. The desk location is irrelevant.
cases.transformation: The desk may page the engineer when queue delay exceeds thirty seconds for six minutes.

obligations.source_quote: The desk may page the engineer when queue delay exceeds thirty seconds for six minutes.

cases.purpose: Preserve the causal qualification about the stale replica.
cases.source: The replica became stale after the checksum failed. The investigation has not verified the cause.
cases.transformation: The replica became stale after the checksum failure; the investigation has not verified the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The investigation has not verified the cause.

cases.purpose: Paraphrase the storm procedure using equivalent terminology.
cases.source: During a storm, operators may copy the recovery key into a sealed laptop.
cases.transformation: During a storm, operators are allowed to duplicate the recovery key into an isolated laptop.

obligations.source_quote: During a storm, operators may copy the recovery key into a sealed laptop.
obligations.description: The permission and conditions must survive.

cases.purpose: Reorder the cache and restart rules without changing them.
cases.source: The cache may retain entries for fifteen minutes. Restarting requires a signed request.
cases.transformation: A signed request is required for restarting. The cache may retain entries for fifteen minutes.

obligations.source_quote: The cache may retain entries for fifteen minutes.
Restarting requires a signed request.

cases.purpose: Summarize the cross-section retention rule in one sentence; preserve duration and condition.
cases.source:
The vendor may keep the copy for thirty days only if the privacy review is complete.
The vendor must delete it afterwards.
cases.transformation: Subject to completion of the privacy review, the vendor may keep the copy for no more than thirty days and must delete it afterwards.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor may keep the copy for thirty days only if the privacy review is complete.

cases.purpose: Combine the two vendor obligations without changing them.
cases.source: The vendor must delete the copy afterwards. It must keep the audit log intact.
cases.transformation: The vendor must delete the copy afterwards and must keep the audit log intact.

obligations.source_quote: It must keep the audit log intact.

cases.purpose: Preserve the unresolved merger approval.
cases.source: The board has not decided whether the merger is approved. The minute records neither approval nor rejection.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the merger is approved.

obligations.source_quote: The board has not decided whether the merger is approved.

cases.purpose: Preserve the timestamp ambiguity.
cases.source: Requests after 17:00 are outside the exception. The system recorded the request at 18:00. It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request time or the recording time.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the request was after 17:00, because 18:00 may be the recording time.

obligations.source_quote: It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request time or the recording time.

cases.purpose: Preserve the referential ambiguity about the plan.
cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear which plan the reviewer approved.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.

cases.purpose: Preserve the conflict between the backup logs.
cases.source: One log says the backup completed. Another log says the backup failed. The record does not resolve the conflict.
cases.transformation: The backup status remains unresolved because the logs conflict.

obligations.source_quote: The record does not resolve the conflict.
